question: Should OpenClaw accept `openclaw.clawFeed.v1` plus `openclaw claws feed inspect/plan` as the next core Claws contract while the base Claws PR and RFC remain open?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and read-only, but it defines public schema, CLI naming, owner/trust metadata, and source-boundary semantics that automation cannot safely choose as product direction.

options.title: Gate on contract approval
options.body: Keep this PR open and require explicit maintainer approval for the feed schema, CLI names, owner/trust fields, and dependency on the base Claws PR before merge.

options.title: Accept the read-only surface now
options.body: A maintainer can intentionally merge this as a read-only contract and own the future compatibility and security implications for feed, install, and provenance work.

options.title: Pause or redirect feed discovery
options.body: If maintainers want ClawHub or plugin-owned discovery to lead instead, pause or close this stacked branch before core grows the feed contract.

recommendation.title: Gate on contract approval
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open and require explicit maintainer approval for the feed schema, CLI names, owner/trust fields, and dependency on the base Claws PR before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the project lead and has the strongest product/CLI contract routing signal for accepting or revising this new core surface.
